The ark is read once here (yotzei ha-tevah — flagged presupposed) [letter facts].

NEVER-AGAIN, PUBLIC EDITION #1 — and a crown-class debut inside it: KARAT ('cut') — TORAH TOKEN 1, NEGATED: the verb that will seal every covenant (likhrot brit, 'to CUT a covenant', from 15:18 on) is born refusing a cutting-off, inside a covenant that is ESTABLISHED, not cut [letter fact; Onkelos renders 'be destroyed' — the cut-play does not survive; dual-track]. MABUL tokens 6-8 in-span — the deluge-word's LAST divine-speech tokens (its remaining four are narrator memory-lines).

The give-verb's OWN ladder begins: ANI NOTEN — 'I AM GIVING' (participle; the perfect follows at 9:13). The span's between-word begins its dozen: BEIN x12 in ten verses — the covenant is drawn as a web of betweens. At Sinai's thunder the nations ask whether He is flooding the world and are answered from it. But what the oath does NOT foreclose is disputed: R. The everlasting rung: U-REITIHA — 'and I will SEE it' (the week's inspection verb aimed at His own sign) — LI-ZEKOR BRIT OLAM ('to REMEMBER the everlasting covenant'): ZAKHAR token 3 — the memory-duty made purposive. And the letter's strangest turn: the parties named in the THIRD PERSON inside God's own speech — 'between ELOHIM and every living soul' [letter fact, held; the chain's readings named-…
FRAME THREE — the seal: the third and last speech-act narrows back to Noach alone (frame one addressed the sons too) [letter fact].

THE LADDER'S LAST RUNG: HAKIMOTI — 'I HAVE ESTABLISHED' (perfect): participle (9:9), weqatal (9:11), perfect (here) — doing, willing, done: the covenant is completed entirely inside speech-grammar, without one narrative deed-verb [letter fact, recorded]. BRIT token 8 and OT token 5 close their clusters; the speech ends where its ladder tops out.
